title: Consensus-only prop edge ignores push on whole-number lines, so edge is overstated
steps: Run evidence/PCFB-002.pipeline.ts, case 2: Fake WR Beta receptions line 5.0, 4 books, czr over +105 vs others around -120
expected: Edge = p_win x decimal + p_push - 1 (README rule). A whole-number line can push.
actual: Un-simulated props use model {win:NaN,push:0}, so consFair.push = 0 and cP (the no-vig over share) is used as win probability: Over 5 shows +6.78% (fair 1.920) with no allowance for the push chance, which on a 5.0 receptions line is material. Overstates edge for the Over when edge>0 (understates push refund). Row is ungraded now (>5% consensus-only) but the 6.78% is shown in feed/props lists; at 2-5% it would be a B.
suspected_area: pricing.ts consFair uses model.push which is 0 for consensus-only props; push is not estimated from the market
